name: @playform/client-dsh-panel-family
description: The central panel package of the UI family: it owns the PANEL CONTRACT and nothing else (Documentation/Plans/UI-Family/PHASE-2-PANEL-CONTRACT.md). The contract types (Source/Interface/Panel.ts) are the only shared artifact in the design; the client half provides the playformFamilyPanel registry service (register / entries / subscribe / getVersion / unregister) and mounts two slot points - the conversation.view family tab (id playform-family, order 20, session scope) and the shell.overlay point for mount:"overlay" panels opened through open(). ZERO adapter logic lives here: the 13 per-bundle adapters register their own sections; this package only renders whatever is registered, ordered by (order, id). The host half of this entry is an empty apply() - the row exists so the client module system serves the half. Locale strings route through the client locale service; visible strings live in Source/Variable/Locale-*.json. Plan: Documentation/Plans/UI-Family/PHASE-2-PANEL-CONTRACT.md; the naming arbitration: Documentation/Plans/UI-Family/BRIEF.md section 6 (one central package, the client- role prefix, no second panel package).
